acceptance_verdict.summary: Phase G NFT Access Lifecycle acceptance COMPLETE. All 10 test steps executed successfully. The NFT temporary-benefit lifecycle works end-to-end: activation creates a time-limited FOMO AI Membership entitlement, idempotency prevents duplicate activations, transfer moves the remaining period to the new owner, expiry correctly terminates the NFT-based access while preserving subscription-based access, and subscription overlap demonstrates multiple independent sources. CRM propagation verified via API. Product and ads regressions confirmed no legacy tiers and correct CMS integration.
acceptance_verdict.production_readiness: The NFT Access Engine is production-ready. All core flows (activation, idempotency, transfer, expiry, subscription overlap) work correctly. AccessResolver correctly grants/denies access based on active membership sources. Public UI renders all NFT states correctly (Available, Active, Transferred, Expired). Product CMS integration ensures single source of truth for pricing and features.
